entries.summary: Thinking mode burns thousands of tokens per answer — painful at the <10 tok/s this dense 32B manages on consumer hardware, especially in agent loops.

mitigations.note: Set enable_thinking=False or append /no_think for tasks that don't need deep reasoning; consider Qwen3-30B-A3B for ~5× the speed at similar quality.

citations.title: NVIDIA docs on Qwen3 thinking-budget control

entries.summary: Endless repetition under greedy decoding — the model card warns against it explicitly.

mitigations.note: Card samplers (0.6/0.95/20 thinking; 0.7/0.8/20 non-thinking); presence_penalty up to 1.5.
